content.text:
Yes. The [methodology page](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/MethodologyPage.svelte:33) uses design system colour tokens:

- Intro text: `--muted`
- Links and quote border: `--accent` (purple by default)
- Link hover: `--text`
- Body text and background inherit `--text` and `--canvas`

There are no hardcoded colours in the page. It automatically follows the design system’s light and dark palettes.
